This PKGBUILD is a clean, standard Python package build script for `sqlite-utils`. It downloads the upstream source from PyPI (`https://pypi.io/packages/source/...`), which is the canonical distribution point for Python packages. The source is pinned via a sha256 checksum, preventing tampering.

The build process follows standard Python packaging conventions: `python -m build --wheel --no-isolation` compiles the package, `pytest` runs the test suite, and `python -m installer` installs the wheel into `$pkgdir`. The LICENSE file is installed at the standard path under `/usr/share/licenses/`.

The `conflicts=("sqlite-utils")` line duplicates the package name, which is a minor cosmetic redundancy but not a security concern. All dependencies are legitimate Python packages from the official repositories. There are no suspicious network requests, no obfuscated code, no downloads from unexpected hosts, and no unusual system modifications.
